g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-301 Ribbon blender 6 cu ft (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: P1-301-102 END PLATE, DRIVE END (welded) 8 [.315] 316L QTY 1 1:4
phantom: shell outside R283 (15 [.59] land all round)
Laser the centre hole to Ø99 [3.898], then bore to Ø100 H9 so the stuffing-box spigot (f8) is a slide fit.
inside corners sharp (cutout matches the shell and end plates); outside corners R5
Laser one piece (no joints). Latch keepers and interlock bracket holes are drilled on assembly (P1-301-003 step 9).
shell end (y = 283): weld edge, cope to R283 if the seat sits low
edge at y = 283: fits the shell side wall (flat zone)
1. Lugs: gusset centred under the seat, square to the shell; seat top at 100 [3.94] above the shaft axis (P1-301-100). The gusset stops 7 [.28] short
of the rail so the seat sits flat and the M12 clears it.
2. All plates: laser to the DXF (mm or inch files identical), remove dross, break edges 0.5. Keep PVC on product sides until welding.
3. Stock: end plates and lugs from one 1219 x 2438 [48 x 96] plate each thickness; the flange from 1219 x 2438 x 6.
